verdict_reasons: Arbitration rule 3: 2 rater disagreements on verifiable (R01, R12) >= 2 -> evidence incomplete.
Primary exact one-sided p = 0.125 > alpha 0.05 -> decision rule rank 2 UNCERTAIN.
E10: failure cells C2 and C4 show no discrimination (per-cell p 1.0 and 0.5 with n=2; the minimum attainable per-cell p is 0.25 > 0.05).

execution.blind_labels: R01..R16 assigned by seeded shuffle; mapping in blind-map.json

rater_agreement.unblinding_markers: none; the token 'experiment' appears only inside the frozen filename EFFECTIVENESS-EXPERIMENT-DESIGN.md

discrimination: 3 of 8 pairs show a positive difference. Direction favours the skill arm, but the evidence is not significant and the failure cells do not discriminate.

threat_reconciliation.V6_post_hoc_tuning: No frozen artifact was edited after unblinding. The scoring rule for dimension 10 was locked in freeze-exec.json before data and is applied as written.
threat_reconciliation.V7_cache_or_timing: Timing is descriptive only; not in the decision rule.
threat_reconciliation.V8_self_check_contamination: The 4 synthetic self-check cases are design fixtures; no real data was reused as a self-check.
threat_reconciliation.V9_hidden_failure_cells: Both failure cells are reported above with effect and per-cell p. E10 fired.

operational_finding: Repeated E2E runs appended 37 synthetic rejection rows to assets/linked-gantt-board/data/rejections.json. This file is untracked runtime state, was not covered by validate_skill.py's runtime_state_files_absent check, and is now reset to []. It is excluded from the release archive. Lesson: every artifact a test writes must be enumerated in the release gate, not only *.db files.
packaging_finding: The package directory also contains external scratch directories (.playwright-mcp/, .research/) with Chinese-language competitive research files. They are the maintainer's own working files, were NOT deleted, and are excluded from the release archive by a hidden-directory rule. Final archive CJK scan = none. Lesson: a package builder must exclude hidden directories by default, not only .git.
structural_finding: With n=2 paired cards per cell, the minimum attainable per-cell exact p is 0.25, which is greater than alpha 0.05. The frozen failure-cell rule therefore makes PASS structurally unreachable at cell level. This is a defect of the frozen C2 design, not of the execution. It is reported honestly and must be fixed only in a NEW freeze id (C5), never by rewording this round.

score_impact.rule_locked_before_data: Dimension 10 reaches 2.0 when this confirmatory round is executed, raw outputs and blind scores are persisted, and the report is reproducible. A FAIL or UNCERTAIN verdict is honest evidence and still completes S5.
score_impact.caveat: 18.0/20 measures evidence availability and release engineering, NOT demonstrated skill effectiveness. The substantive question 'does the skill improve AI-led engineering?' remains UNCERTAIN.
